name: OrangeHRM — authentication and workflow discovery
task_description: Use only this public OrangeHRM demo at *|base_url|. Goal: discover and validate the authenticated application's main navigation as a documentation/testing bootstrap. Open login, submit empty fields and assert required-field validation. Enter *|cqa_username| and *|cqa_password| using environment values; never copy credentials into descriptions or logs. Sign in, wait until the dashboard is fully loaded, assert Dashboard and user menu are visible. Inspect the sidebar and record which modules are actually available. Visit PIM Employee List and assert its search form and results area are visible. Visit Directory and assert its search interface is visible. Return to Dashboard.
